goal.vi: Cập nhật tiến độ, xin phát biểu, đưa ý kiến và hứa việc tiếp theo.
goal.en: Give an update, ask to speak, suggest an idea and agree on next steps.

lines: Okay, let's get started. First, the project timeline. Any updates?
Yes. We're on track for the first part, but testing might take a bit longer than planned.
How much longer, do you think?
Probably one more week. Could I add something?
I think we need one more person on testing. That way, we can still finish on time.
That's a good point. Can you send me the details?
Of course. I'll follow up by email after the meeting.
Great. Let's move on to the budget.

mean.vi: Báo công việc đang đúng kế hoạch
mean.en: Say the work is going as planned

why.vi: "On track" nghĩa là công việc đang theo đúng kế hoạch.
why.en: "On track" means the work is going as planned.

mean.vi: Xin phát biểu trong cuộc họp
mean.en: Ask to speak in a meeting

why.vi: Dùng "Could I add something?" để tham gia thảo luận lịch sự.
why.en: Use "Could I add something?" to join the discussion politely.

phrases.say: It might take a bit longer than planned.
phrases.not: It will be late, sorry, my fault.

mean.vi: Báo tin chậm trễ một cách bình tĩnh
mean.en: Give news about a delay calmly

why.vi: "Might take longer" báo tin xấu rõ ràng, bình tĩnh, không hoảng.
why.en: "Might take longer" gives bad news clearly and calmly, without panic.

phrases.say: That way, we can still finish on time.
phrases.not: So we finish on time maybe.

mean.vi: Nối ý kiến với kết quả rõ ràng
mean.en: Link your idea to a clear result

why.vi: "That way…" cho thấy ý của bạn dẫn tới kết quả gì.
why.en: "That way…" shows what result your idea will bring.

phrases.not: You are right, I am wrong.

mean.vi: Đồng ý với một ý hay

why.vi: Câu này khen ý tưởng mà không biến thành chuyện ai đúng ai sai.
why.en: This praises the idea without making it about who is right.

phrases.say: Just to clarify, do you mean next Friday?
phrases.not: I don't understand what you say.

mean.vi: Kiểm tra lại một chi tiết

why.vi: "Just to clarify…" kiểm tra chi tiết và cho thấy bạn đang nghe kỹ.
why.en: "Just to clarify…" checks a detail and shows you are listening carefully.

phrases.not: I will send you email later after.

mean.vi: Hứa gửi thêm thông tin sau
mean.en: Promise to send more information later

why.vi: "Follow up" là gửi thêm thông tin hoặc kiểm tra lại sau – cho thấy bạn sẽ hành động.
why.en: "Follow up" means sending more information or checking later – it shows you will act.

ai.name: Rosa
ai.persona: busy but fair, likes clear answers
ai.goal: get a project update and a plan

roleplay.you: Give a short update, explain a small delay, suggest a solution and promise to follow up.

turns.a: Okay, let's get started. Can you give us a quick update on your project?
turns.h: Sure. We're on track for the first part.

turns.a: And what about testing? Any problems?
turns.h: Testing might take a bit longer than planned.

turns.a: Hmm. Do you have any ideas to fix that?
turns.h: Could I suggest adding one more person to testing? That way, we can finish on time.

turns.a: Can you send me the details after the meeting?
turns.h: Of course. I'll follow up by email this afternoon.

roleplay.end: Thanks, everyone. Let's move on to the budget.
